dogecoin.text: Will people be buying yachts with their Dogecoin riches some day? Probably not. But are we having a lot of fun, helping great causes and spreading the digital currency word in the process? Yes we are. And perhaps if we pool our Dogecoin together we can build a Dogeyacht and sail https://t.co/btK3jMo3YA

The half-life of monetary energy stored in a weak fiat currency is approximately 2 years.  The half-life of money in a strong fiat currency is ~5 years.  The half-life of #dogecoin is ~25 years.  The half-life of #bitcoin  is forever. https://t.co/ZnTYlLKTsz
